name: Closed enzyme and substrate-moiety pools
description: Check E+ES=E_total and S+ES+P=S_total for the declared E+S<=>ES->E+P mechanism, plus species nonnegativity.
assumptions: Illustrative species concentrations, not measured data.
Fixed volume; closed enzyme and substrate-moiety pools; no synthesis, degradation, inlet, outlet, or additional bound species.
One substrate moiety in ES and one in P; catalytic turnover regenerates E.
Species-level bookkeeping: this is not a complete elemental, charge, thermodynamic or kinetic model.
Buffered pH and transformed sums of species require a separate declared conservation model; do not impose hydrogen-ion conservation on a chemostatted pH buffer.
metric: Euclidean distance in x=(E,ES,S,P)/concentration_scale_uM. Pool fields are oriented exact distances to hyperplanes; equality, not either halfspace, is the constraint.
